content.text:
I'm not deciding anything today. I'll ask you, and I'm not sure of any of it. The page puts a star and the word "הזול" (the cheapest) next to "פסגות" and a fund called "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". It says that after ten years, with 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month, I'd have about 86,492 ₪ from the 70,000 ₪ I put in. The names Yelin Lapidot and Psagot I know a little, so that part caught my eye. But I didn't understand what "מחקה" means or why the bank wasn't first.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. **The top.** The big heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן" was clear. Straight after it came buttons in English letters: S&P 500, MSCI, נאסד"ק. To me "מדד" is the price index on the news. If you hadn't sent me, I'd have left here.
2. **The boxes with numbers.** I saw 10,000, 500, 10 years and 7%, which seem to be filled in already. Under them were sliders, and I didn't touch those. The big numbers stayed with me: 70,000 ₪ put in, 86,492 ₪ at the end.
3. **The coloured bar** under "כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים". It had pink, yellow, orange and green, and the colours were too close for me to tell apart. I understood that the long pink part is "מס" (tax), 5,703 ₪. The total was about 6,876 ₪.
4. **Two long lists side by side.** Banks on the right: פסגות, לאומי 83,396, דיסקונט, מזרחי טפחות. Funds on the left. On screens two and three there are minus signs everywhere, in red or pink: ‎-1,268, ‎-3,671, ‎-4,492, even ‎-23,766. Every minus makes me back away. Lots of English: iShares, Vanguard, UCITS, ETF. A grey box popped up over the list ("מס רק במכירה"), covered what I was reading, and I couldn't read it properly.
5. **Screen three.** I read the part "מה כתוב בפרסום, מול התעריף". It says that at 6 places, what's in the advertisement doesn't match the price list. That worried me. It also says "הרבה פעמים אפשר לקבל מחיר טוב יותר במשא ומתן עם הבנק", which I did understand. Then a chart with lines started, and that's where I stopped. I didn't open screens four to six; I was tired.

**Words and signs I didn't understand:** S&P 500, ETF, UCITS, Accumulating, "מחקה", "צוברת", "4D", "4A", "מנוטרל מט"ח", "דמי משמרת", "קרן סל", "מול המדד", "W-8BEN", "תשואה בשנה 7%", and the "+0.37%" and "‎-0.53%" in the "מול המדד" column. I couldn't read the grey lines inside the list, or the small text under each bank's name. The dark background made the pale text even harder to read.

**What bothered me:** the screen is black and full of numbers, colours and red minus signs. It never says whether this is as safe as a deposit, and it doesn't talk about deposits at all. I didn't find out whether my bank takes too much from me.
